name: Okura Garden Hotel
detail: This was my second stay this year. I made a reservation because the overall advantages outweighed my curiosity to try other hotels. The cleaning was thorough, and the amenities were abundant. The water quality and pressure were good, the bath was spacious, and in addition to the solid feel of the building, the staff provided a sense of stability, making me feel at ease when returning from outings. I was looking forward to the buffet-style breakfast after swimming in the pool. The hotel is located almost in the center of Shanghai, close to a subway station, and it coexists with both the latest brand buildings and local shops, making for pleasant walks on the premises. Additionally, since it is in the former French Concession area, exploring the surroundings was also enjoyable. I was very satisfied to be able to stay at such a high-quality hotel at a special rate.
area: Xintiandi and Huaihai Rd,Shanghai - View on map

name: Hi Cozy Youth Hostel East Nanjing Road & The Bund
detail: This is my second time in Shanghai, but since it's my first overseas trip alone, I had a lot of worries. However, the hostel was much better than I expected, and I had a great stay! If you book a twin room with a window, you will be really satisfied. The water pressure is good, and there is a hairdryer available. The common areas are spacious and comfortable, which is nice! The location is just a 5-minute walk from Nanjing East Road, so I was able to travel safely even in the early morning! Towels are provided unlimited, and the staff is very friendly, which helped me finish my trip well. I am very thankful to the LEO staff who kindly assisted me even when I checked out early in the morning! Thank you! 🙏🏻
area: People Square and South Bund Huangpu,Shanghai - View on map

name: Golden Tulip Shanghai Hong Qiao
detail: It was truly a place where I experienced proper 4-star hotel service. Many other places that claim to be 4-star often feel more like 2-star, which can be disappointing, but here the atmosphere, room conditions, and service were overall very satisfying. The room was tidy and well-maintained, and the bedding was so comfortable that it was great for a good rest. The bathroom was also clean and well-kept, so I was satisfied throughout my stay. The staff's responses were friendly and attentive, allowing me to have a pleasant experience during my time there. Above all, what I found most satisfying was being able to stay at a hotel of this quality for such a price, and if I go to Shanghai again, it’s a place I would want to visit without hesitation.
area: New Hongqiao Commercial Center and Changning,Shanghai - View on map

name: Artyzen Habitat Hongqiao Shanghai
detail: It is close to Hongqiao Airport and within a 10-minute walk to Koreatown. There are nearby shopping malls, and it was safe to move around in the evening. Karry Wang staff were kind and able to communicate in Korean, which was a great help.
area: Hongqiao Airport and National Convention Center,Shanghai - View on map

name: Philosopher Hotel
detail: It has good access to tourist spots, and the subway is right underneath the hotel. It's perfect for those who want to avoid dormitories and prefer a private room with at least minimal water facilities inside, while keeping costs low. The shower and toilet are small, but there are slippers provided, so it's fine.
area: People Square and South Bund Huangpu,Shanghai - View on map

name: Shanghai Fish Inn East Nanjing Road
detail: The room condition is much better than expected. It is very spacious, the bed is large, and when you pull back the curtains, sunlight comes in. It's a non-smoking room, so there's no smell of cigarettes at all, and the cleaning staff were very friendly. The location is very close to the center, allowing for a morning run along the Huangpu River, while still being in a quiet alley, which is nice. However, there are two Fish N' locations nearby, so you need to be careful when ordering delivery or taking a taxi. Lastly, there is occasionally a cat on the first floor that is very, very fat and cute. That alone is worth a perfect score.
area: The Bund and North Bund,Shanghai - View on map

name: Paramount Gallery Hotel
detail: I have traveled to various countries and accommodations through Agoda, but this is my first time writing a review. The cleanliness of the accommodation and the bedding were good, and there are signs that every detail has been carefully considered. I had breakfast, and you can see the care put into it as well. This is a really great place to stay. Thanks to this, my trip to Shanghai was very enjoyable.
area: Jing'an and SHA Railway Station,Shanghai - View on map

name: Himalayas Hotel Shanghai
detail: The location is excellent for going to the exhibition hall, and the size of the rooms and the quick response for the makeup room are very good. The staff is very friendly, and the breakfast is varied and well-prepared! In particular, the fruits were very fresh and delightful.
area: Lujiazui and New Int'l Expo Center Pudong,Shanghai - View on map

name: URSIDE Hotel Shanghai South Bund
detail: I stayed for 2 nights in a single room and 2 nights in a garden view loft, and I recommend it. The hotel itself has no cigarette smell, the bedding is comfortable, and the hotel design and facilities are good for the price. The first floor of the hotel has a restaurant and café, which serves a big breakfast style if you request breakfast, and guests can enjoy a free cup of coffee every day. The staff is friendly. Although they don't speak English, I communicated with Papago, and everyone was very helpful. Especially the gentleman with glasses was very kind. The location can be both a disadvantage or an advantage; the subway station is easily accessible to tourist attractions, but it is a bit far to walk to the station (around 15-20 minutes). I bought a bike rental voucher with Alipay, and the bike parking area is right in front of the hotel, so I can ride out immediately. I also think they rent out bikes at the hotel. Walking to places each time might be difficult, so it's better to use a bike or taxi. The advantage of the location is that if you walk a bit in front of the hotel, you will reach the Huangpu River promenade, which is very nice for a walk. When you walk happily, you can easily walk for about an hour and get close to Yuyuan Garden. There’s also a ferry station along the way, so if you time it right, you can take the boat to the Oriental Pearl Tower. It took about 15 minutes by bike from the hotel to the ferry terminal. The location is a bit far from the station, so there aren't many people, and it was the most pleasant neighborhood I've visited in Shanghai, which is filled with cigarette smoke. The single room is perfect for travelers looking to save money. You can enjoy a comfortable single room (with a shared bathroom) for the price of a 6-bed dorm in a hostel, and the café is spacious, making it great for planning your trip or relaxing while having coffee. The garden view loft isn't exactly a garden, but during the day you can see lush leaves and at night, there's a nice view of a bridge in front, and you can watch Chinese content or foreign movies on the TV through an OTT service. There are no convenience stores nearby, so you should bring some supplies with you, and there aren’t many cafes or restaurants around. There is the Shanghai Modern Art Museum nearby, so I enjoyed the exhibitions there. In other hotels, I could smell cigarette smoke through vents or hallways, but there was none of that here, so it was very pleasant! It has a duplex space, making the room spacious. The single room also has a nice design. There were two types of pillows, memory foam and regular pillows available (in the single room as well). I was very satisfied with this design hotel.
area: People Square and South Bund Huangpu,Shanghai - View on map

name: City Hotel
detail: I stayed for three nights for my trip to Shanghai. I was considering booking a place on Nanjing East Road, but since it was just a 10-minute taxi ride to the city center, I reserved this affordable place instead. I was worried because there weren't many reviews, but after actually going, I was satisfied. The price was not expensive, and although it was slightly older, the room was clean and they cleaned it every day. The front desk staff were also kind, and above all, the view from the room and the atmosphere of the nearby neighborhood were nice. It was good for walking, and there were many places to eat at night. I liked it in many ways. It was also conveniently a 10-minute taxi ride to the city center on Nanjing East Road. It’s a place I would like to visit again.
area: Xintiandi and Huaihai Rd,Shanghai - View on map
